Let's write the build code carefully:

```cpp
const Profile::MESG* Profile::GetMesg(const FIT_UINT16 num)
{
    static FIT_UINT16 start[257] = { 0 };
    static FIT_UINT8 pool_low[MESGS];
    static FIT_UINT16 pool_idx[MESGS];
    static bool init = false;

    if (!init)
    {
        // Count frequencies of high bytes
        for (int i = 0; i < MESGS; ++i)
        {
            FIT_UINT16 h = (FIT_UINT16)(mesgs[i].num >> 8);
            ++start[h + 1];
        }
        // Prefix sum
        for (int h = 1; h <= 256; ++h)
        {
            start[h] += start[h - 1];
        }
        // Place entries
        FIT_UINT16 cur[256];
        for (int h = 0; h < 256; ++h)
        {
            cur[h] = start[h];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MESGS; ++i)
        {
            FIT_UINT16 h = (FIT_UINT16)(mesgs[i].num >> 8);
            FIT_UINT16 pos = cur[h]++;
            pool_low[pos] = (FIT_UINT8)(mesgs[i].num & 0xFF);
            pool_idx[pos] = (FIT_UINT16)i;
        }
        init = true;
    }

    const FIT_UINT16 h = (FIT_UINT16)(num >> 8);
    const FIT_UINT8 low = (FIT_UINT8)(num & 0xFF);
    const FIT_UINT16 end = start[h + 1];
    for (FIT_UINT16 pos = start[h]; pos < end; ++pos)
    {
        if (pool_low[pos] == low)
        {
            return &mesgs[pool_idx[pos]];
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}
```
